about.title: About
about.tagline: Setlists, lyrics and chords — ready for the stage.
about.projectDescription: Setlyst is a lyrics and chords library built for live performance. Singers and musicians keep their repertoire, running order, keys and tempos in one place, and take it on stage with a Live Mode designed to be read from a mic stand — with metronome, live transpose, auto-scroll and full offline support.
about.openSource: It's open source: a Next.js web app and a Rust API, developed in the open on GitHub. Made by musicians, for musicians.
about.author: Author
about.authorRole: Guitarist, guitar teacher and software developer
about.authorBio: Setlyst is designed and built by a working guitarist who also writes software — so every feature is shaped by what's actually needed on stage.
about.contributeTitle: Found a bug or have an idea?
about.contributeDescription: Issues and pull requests are welcome.
